title: Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker who, after being cured of compleation, tries to reimagine the Multiverse and ends up shattered by his own spell.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon formerly compleated and cured, who helps Jace and learns she has lost her Planeswalker's spark.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A creature held in stasis for millennia in the Vault on Thunder Junction, able to visualize Omenpaths across the Multiverse.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A figure Jace, disguised as Ashiok, hires to find the vault key on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A figure whose appearance Jace takes on to fool Eriette and to hire Oko.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A witch of Eldraine whom Jace tries to recruit while disguised as Ashiok.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A member of Vraska's old crew whom she recruits on Ixalan.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A member of Vraska's old crew whom she recruits on Ixalan.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A great detective of Ravnica whose magic projects his psychic print into reality; Jace steals one of his files.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A character who nearly took the vault key from Oko on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A planeswalker whose special mindset helps clear the others' minds in the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who follows a lead to the Meditation Realm and attacks Bolas to distract him.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An elder dragon and planeswalker sealed in the Meditation Realm, whose Spirit-Gem Jace steals.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon and planeswalker sealed in the Meditation Realm who escapes after Jace's spell.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who assaults Ugin on Tarkir and is defeated with ghostfire.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who suffers headaches and dreams after Jace's attack and hunts for him on Arcavios.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker on Arcavios who receives a white-aligned version of herself as a visitor.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker whose alternate black-aligned version visits the University on Arcavios.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: A gorgon Strixhaven student who pushes Jadzi into wild magic and jumps in after her.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: An Oracle who performs a ritual to calm the Dawning Archaic.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: A Strixhaven student who discovers a parallel copy of the Multiverse is being created.

entities.name: The Shattered
entities.description: A group of former Oriq pyromancers whom Chandra takes under her wing.

entities.name: Dawning Archaic
entities.description: An Archaic that Chandra believes is the vessel at the center of Jace's plan; it emits reality-warping magic.

entities.name: Meditation Plane
entities.description: A silvery plane where Ugin and Bolas were sealed and where Jace casts his spell.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: A plane where the Vault holding Loot is found.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane of Strixhaven University, where the Echoverse begins.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane where Ugin arrives and defeats Sarkhan Vol.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: A plane where Jace first goes to recruit the witch Eriette.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane where Vraska recruits Malcolm and Breeches.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane where Jace accesses the mind of Alquist Proft.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths across the Multiverse that Jace and Vraska distrust and that Loot can visualize.

entities.name: Spirit-Gem
entities.description: Ugin's gem whose power Jace steals to cast his spell.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: A new reality being built from Jace's remnants, free of pain, starting on Arcavios.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: A conflict that concluded while Jace and Vraska were healing.

events.summary: Jace Beleren tries to reimagine the Multiverse so the New Phyrexian Invasion, the Desparkening and the Omenpaths never happened.
events.quote: Jace Beleren tried to reimagine the Multiverse into a form where the New Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: Cured of compleation, Jace and Vraska learn of the Omenpaths, distrust them and plot a rebirth of the Multiverse.
events.quote: They desired an end to the multiversal conflicts that had scarred them and plotted a rebirth of the Multiverse.

events.summary: Vraska discovers she has lost her Planeswalker's spark, thwarting their first plan involving the Vault.
events.quote: their plan was thwarted when Vraska discovered that she had lost her Planeswalker's spark

events.summary: Jace disguises himself as Ashiok on Eldraine to recruit the witch Eriette.
events.quote: Jace started on Eldraine , where he disguised himself as Ashiok to fool the witch Eriette into working with them.

events.summary: Vraska returns to Ixalan to recruit Malcolm and Breeches from her old crew.
events.quote: Vraska returned to Ixalan to recruit Malcolm and Breeches from her old crew.

events.summary: On Ravnica Jace enters Alquist Proft's mind, knocks him out with a lead pipe, forces him to project his mental library and steals one of his files.
events.quote: He knocked Proft unconscious with a lead pipe, forced him to project his mental library, stole one of the files containing his knowledge

events.summary: Disguised as Ashiok, Jace hires Oko to find the vault key, while Vraska joins Oko's gang.
events.quote: Jace disguised himself as Ashiok and hired Oko to find the vault key

events.summary: Jace helps Oko secure the key from Kellan, opens the vault and finds Loot; the vault collapses as Jace and Vraska vanish with Loot.
events.quote: Triggering the vault's collapse, Jace and Vraska disappeared with Loot.

events.summary: Jace and Vraska learn Loot can visualize Omenpaths across the Multiverse, letting Jace create an illusory map with Proft's magic.
events.quote: learning that he was able to visualize Omenpaths across the entire Multiverse

events.summary: Jace and Vraska reach the Meditation Plane via an ancient Omenpath, meet Narset and Elspeth, and are confronted by the two sealed elder dragons.
events.quote: To their shock, they were met by the two elder dragons that had been sealed away here in eternal lockdown.

events.summary: Ugin berates Jace for breaking their agreement and warns them away, while Bolas sees a chance to gain information and power.
events.quote: the nameless dragon that had been Nicol Bolas saw a chance to gain information and regain power.

events.summary: While the others are distracted, Jace steals Ugin's Spirit-Gem and begins casting his spell.
events.quote: He secretly moved behind Ugin's back and stole his Spirit-Gem .

events.summary: Elspeth attacks Bolas to distract him and Vraska tries to hold Jace back, but he proceeds.
events.quote: Thinking that he would offer the Gem to Bolas, Elspeth attacked and temporarily distracted him.

events.summary: Jace's spell fails because he is only human; the horizon shatters, a void unmakes reality and Jace shatters like glass.
events.quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

events.summary: Everyone including Bolas flees the Realm; Ugin arrives on Tarkir and easily defeats Sarkhan Vol with ghostfire, though Bolas has escaped.
events.quote: He was immediately assaulted by Sarkhan Vol but defeated him with ease using ghostfire .

events.summary: A reflected silhouette of a mage in a blue cloak manifests in the Realm's waters and begins constructing a new reality.
events.quote: He began constructing a new reality, painstakingly calculating and recalculating the variables necessary.

events.summary: Strange events occur on Arcavios as alternate versions of Liliana and Ral appear.
events.quote: Liliana Vess received another strange visitor: a white -aligned version of herself.

events.summary: Chandra arrives on Arcavios searching for Jace, takes in the Shattered and hunts the Dawning Archaic.
events.quote: Arriving on Arcavios , she met the Shattered , a group of former Oriq pyromancers.

events.summary: Tam pushes Jadzi into the wild magic and jumps in after her; both reappear in a warped alternate Strixhaven.
events.quote: Tam pushed Jadzi into the nexus of wild magic and bade the others a tearful farewell before jumping into it herself.

events.summary: Zimone Wola discovers a parallel Multiverse is being created and a spell reveals the image of Chandra.
events.quote: the image of Chandra was revealed.

events.summary: The Theorist excises elements from planes' histories to build the Echoverse, but paradoxes pile up and he must lay it atop the existing Multiverse.
events.quote: The only way to give it stability was to lay its skin atop the bones of the existing Multiverse.

relations.note: They plot the rebirth of the Multiverse together.
relations.quote: They desired an end to the multiversal conflicts that had scarred them and plotted a rebirth of the Multiverse.

relations.note: Jace steals Ugin's gem; Ugin berates him.
relations.quote: He secretly moved behind Ugin's back and stole his Spirit-Gem .

relations.note: Sarkhan attacks Ugin and is defeated.
relations.quote: He was immediately assaulted by Sarkhan Vol but defeated him with ease using ghostfire .

relations.note: Chandra takes the group under her wing.
relations.quote: She took the group under her wing, offering them a second chance.

relations.note: Vraska joins the gang Oko puts together.
relations.quote: Vraska joined the gang Oko put together, presumably to keep an eye on him.
